lines.say: switches on GIP and GLP-1 receptors; both hormones help regulate blood sugar and appetite
stomach emptying slows, which can change warfarin absorption, so INR is checked
15% to 21% less body weight in 72 weeks, versus 3% on placebo; most returns after stopping
breathing pauses in sleep apnea with obesity fell 51% to 59% in 52 weeks, vs 3% on placebo
kidney function checked if vomiting or diarrhea is severe; dehydration can injure them
boxed warning: thyroid C-cell tumors in rats; unknown in humans
acute pancreatitis, a label warning, though rates matched placebo in weight trials
gallstones and gallbladder inflammation; inflammation in 0.7% versus 0.2% on placebo
low blood sugar is more likely with insulin or a sulfonylurea, so it's checked
nausea in about 1 in 4 versus 8% on placebo, plus diarrhea, vomiting and constipation

ask: What is our plan if I stop, given that most of the weight tends to return?
